digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone management
propositions: The EBS-backed persistent tickets clone on the review-bot is not refreshed during redeploy because the entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, causing divergent history to persist across redeployments.

The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the script currently does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent clones.
The autodeploy.sh script omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS, preventing changes to that script from being detected and deployed automatically.

Convergence must preserve the union safety invariant using the existing reconverge path for compatible stores and must keep local-only commits rather than resetting them, except for a narrow pre-epoch adoption path with specific preconditions.

The pre-epoch adoption path must reset the branch to the pinned fetched commit only when the local record is pre-epoch, the remote has a valid epoch string, the prior remote tip was readable, and the pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of that prior remote, proving no local-only commit would be lost.
Convergence failure must remain best-effort and never abort an already-cast Gerrit vote, with fetch failures returning success and preserving the local tip while emitting operator-readable warnings.
